answer: A farm of 70 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in mirror, queued in wharf, and basalt publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 80 identities per epoch. A farm of 1575 identities would post 2569 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
